name: Beatrice Lee “Bette” Jones (Barton, Simons)
sources: Obituary of Carl Ray Simons, Fisher-Cheney Funeral Home, Troy, Aug 2025
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree" (tree 4662169)
notes: Beatrice Lee "Bette" Jones (1921–1995), earlier Mrs. Barton, was Elmer Simons's second wife: they married on 10 Nov 1969 at Pasco, and the tree records a second marriage about 1980 (Kulp-Ritchey-Dorsett Family Tree). His first wife was Wilma K. Hardy.

CORRECTION 2026-09-24: Carl Ray and Debra Sue were adopted by Elmer and his first wife, Wilma (Hardy); Bette was their stepmother. Carl Ray's 2025 obituary names his parents as Wilma and Elmer, and the tree dates Elmer's marriage to Bette to 1969.
